source_player_input: Мы откапываемся и ждём помощи, с нападающими я помогу. В конфликт не вступаем. #к медсестре# сообщите своим шиноби о нападении #захожу в медицинское крыло#
player_action: Shiki tells allies to entrench/defend, await reinforcements, avoid initiating conflict, offers to help with attackers, directs nurse to alert Konoha shinobi about assault, then enters infirmary. He does not independently initiate other actions, orders or speech.

events.summary: Ren agrees defensive posture, states alternative exit through dressing-supply storage leads to lower service floor, safety unknown. Nurse plans to report by internal line, sees critical Sound attackers outside, asks if alive, then closes outer door.

Shiki enters room 4; Aki alive conscious with immobilized swollen left lower leg, sees Shiki uninjured, asks for details. Ren says Sound ninja attacked and Shiki stopped them; Aki notes it, asks about other patients.

Six patients in wing, four ambulatory, of whom one unsteady post-concussion; Aki and one patient with pelvic injury non-ambulatory. Ren and orderlies move willing ambulatory patients into interior hall and move stretchers away from windows. Medical staff set movable cabinets as partial barrier while preserving evacuation route. Aki urges Ren to verify second exit without opening exterior; Ren does so.

Nurse reports she made contact with Konoha security, told them Sound shinobi assaulted hospital wing, six patients, assistance promised with no ETA. This is nurse's statement, not proof of reinforcement arrival.

Male voice at shut main door claims third group of Konoha west-tribune security under commander Morita, requests opening for wounded. Ren challenges for unit/commander. Neither Ren nor nurse recognizes unit or commander. Second voice begs over bleeding man. Heavy metallic object set down, blood seeps under door; identities unknown, may be genuine or trap. Nurse tempted to open; Ren warns not to trust. Shiki near nurses' station, door shut, patients inside, no action declared in response yet.

tactical: Six patients, two nonambulatory. Nurse and Ren at outer door, staff as available. Closed external door with unknown persons claiming security. Other exit through dressing supplies to lower service level; unverified safe. Konoha notified via internal line, reinforcements not yet present.
